text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Ugh. My weight is in pretty serious trouble...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I really need to cut back...!
I have to cut down on snacks and sweets as much as possible—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, but wasn't I supposed to go to the all-you-can-eat sweets buffet with Ikuno-chan tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Guess my diet starts the day after tomorrow, then.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... I'm stuffed. Everything was delicious,
just as the rave reviews said."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Ahh, I'm so full, it hurts~!
There were way too many kinds of cake, I couldn't conquer them all. We gotta come back.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I shall take my leave here.
I plan to run on my way back to burn off the calories I just consumed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You're gonna run?
Even though it's pretty far...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In fact, my calculations show that even if I run all the way back,
I won't be able to burn it all off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so.
Was today's calorie count really that high...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Um, maybe I should run home too...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind,
would you care to join me from tomorrow on as well, and not just today?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I have already devised a training plan
that will completely burn off
today's caloric intake.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-chan's plan... that's guaranteed to be totally flawless!
Please let me train together with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with Ikuno Dictus's help,
Hishi Miracle successfully managed to diet.
